transcript:
Speaker A: Sir, Lalbag Kaise Jaun? [Sir, how do I go to Lalbag?]
Speaker B: Just take the number 25 C bus from here and then it's only a short walk from there.
Speaker A: Sir samjha nahi. Mujhe English achhi tarah nahi aati. [Sir, I didn't understand. I don't know English very well.]
Speaker B: Are aajkal ke jamane mein English seekhna to bahut zaruri hai. Seekh kyun nahi lete? [Oh, in today's era, learning English is very important. Why don't you learn?]
Speaker A: Sir, mere paas samay kahan hai? Aapne kahan se seekhi? [Sir, where do I have the time? Where did you learn from?]
Speaker B: Maine to Speak Easy app se seekhi hai. Aur jyada samay ki bhi zarurat nahi hai. Is app par bas 10 se 15 minute practice karo aur kuchh hi dino mein tumhari English behtar ho jayegi. [I learned from the Speak Easy app. And you don't need much time either. Just practice for 10 to 15 minutes on this app and in a few days your English will get better.]
Speaker A: Is Speak Easy app kya hai? [What is this Speak Easy app?]
Speaker B: Is app mein ek AI teacher hai jiske sath tum bina kisi jhijhak ya dar ke English practice kar sakte ho. Aur sabse achhi baat, agar tum galti karoge to AI use turant sahi bhi kar degi. [In this app, there is an AI teacher with whom you can practice English without any hesitation or fear. And the best part, if you make a mistake, the AI will correct it immediately.]
Speaker A: Par sir, yeh app to mehanga hoga na? [But sir, this app must be expensive, right?]
Speaker B: Bilkul nahi. Maine to sirf ’1 mein shuruaat ki thi. Tum bhi kar sakte ho. [Not at all. I started with just ’1. You can too.]
Speaker A: Kaise shuru karun? [How do I start?]
Speaker B: Bas install button par click karo. Speak Easy app install karo aur apni English seekhne ki yatra shuru karo. [Just click on the install button. Install the Speak Easy app and start your English learning journey.]
Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: A young man asks a traffic policeman for directions in Hindi, but the policeman responds in fluent English. When the young man admits he doesn't understand English, the policeman recommends the Speakeasy app, explaining that its AI teacher helps users practice without fear and corrects mistakes instantly for just ’1. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app and start speaking fluent English.
